input.rationale: Section 12.b gives a TrueLink indemnity, but it is limited to claims "arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder" (p0075). It therefore does not cover third-party claims that the Interface, Hosting Services or Support Services infringe or misappropriate IP rights, nor TrueLink's breach of law, data breach or wilful misconduct as independent triggers, and no IP infringement indemnity appears elsewhere. Because a Vendor IP indemnity is absent, the clause fails even the fallback, while the Client indemnity at 12.a is an open-ended indemnity of TrueLink and its licensors. The redline inserts the missing TrueLink indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, TrueLink-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice, control and cooperation procedure, and narrows Client's indemnity at 12.a to Client Content and Client's breach of applicable law.

ops.oldText: a. Client shall indemnify and hold TrueLink, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to the following:
ops.newText: a. Client shall indemnify and hold TrueLink, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to the following, in each case solely to the extent arising from Client Content or Client's breach of applicable law:

ops.text: c. Without limiting the foregoing, TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable furnished by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall control the defense, and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity at 12.b reaches only its own breach of this Agreement, so we have added clause c. covering third-party IP infringement claims against the Interface and Services, TrueLink's breach of law, TrueLink-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with the usual notice, control and cooperation procedure. We have also narrowed Client's indemnity at 12.a to Client Content and Client's breach of applicable law, consistent with our playbook position.
proposal.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct; limit Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law
